facts.value: The execution phase is where the project plan is implemented. Tasks are performed, resources are utilized, and the project team collaborates to achieve project objectives.

value: Completing assigned tasks according to schedule
Ensuring work meets required quality standards

facts.value: Project managers play a crucial role in coordinating team efforts and maintaining project momentum.
The monitoring and controlling phase occurs alongside execution. It focuses on tracking project progress and ensuring that the project stays aligned with the plan.

value: Maintaining quality control of project deliverables

facts.value: This phase helps ensure the project remains on schedule and within scope and budget.
The closure phase marks the formal completion of the project. All project activities are finalized and deliverables are handed over to stakeholders.

value: Documenting project reports and lessons learned
Conducting a final evaluation of project performance

facts.value: Proper project closure ensures knowledge gained during the project is documented for future improvements.
